title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: FedEx St. Jude Championship
items.text: Michael Thorbjornsen leads a five-way tie at -5, including Jordan Spieth, Kurt Kitayama, Jake Knapp, and Michael Kim through the completed round.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark’s Playoff Hurdle
items.text: Despite a strong PGA Tour season, Golfweek’s Eamon Lynch says Wyndham Clark is “too polarising” to win Player of the Year as FedEx Cup Playoffs begin.

items.headline: Jon Rahm’s LIV Future Uncertain
items.text: Jon Rahm faces speculation about leaving LIV Golf in 2027, amid potential DP World Tour fines and suspensions impacting LIV players.
